biotools.summary: haploMAGIC is a pipeline for detecting crossovers in multiparental populations using SNP data, leveraging pedigree relationships for accurate genotype phasing and inference of grandparental haplotypes. It filters for genotyping errors, improving accuracy in complex plant genome analysis.
